accuracy.title: AI Accuracy & Evaluation
accuracy.subtitle: Benchmarked performance metrics against the official demonstration dataset
accuracy.disclaimer: Metrics shown in this prototype are based on the available demonstration dataset and should not be interpreted as production field accuracy.

privacy.title: Privacy-Preserving AI Architecture
privacy.subtitle: Strict compliance with Indian Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), 2023
privacy.face_id_note: Hardware and software controls prohibit individual identity extraction or facial biometric harvesting.
never_items: No individual identity, name, or gender profiling
No long-term raw video storage on servers
No tracking across different training centres

low_bandwidth.title: Low-Bandwidth Mode
low_bandwidth.subtitle: Optimized edge intelligence for remote and rural skill centres with limited 2G/3G connectivity
low_bandwidth.toggle_desc: Reduces frame sampling rate from 5 to 15 frames, sends aggregated metadata only, and avoids raw video transmission.
low_bandwidth.bandwidth_savings_note: Enables reliable daily compliance audits across remote tribal and rural mandals.

settings.title: System Settings & Thresholds
settings.subtitle: Configure regulatory compliance weights and computer vision parameters
settings.formula_desc: Overall Score = Attendance Score × Attendance Weight + Infrastructure Score × Infrastructure Weight
